The status quo

The Problem With Spreadsheet Increments

⚠️

Zero Transparency

Employees never know why they got (or didn't get) an increment. Trust erodes — silently, until it's too late.

💸

Budget Overruns

Criteria set without simulation. Too many qualify. Finance scrambles to cover the gap after the cycle is already live.

⚖️

Compliance Risk

No audit trail. Pay equity laws are tightening globally. Spreadsheets can't defend decisions when regulators ask.

The process

How MeritCyc Works

01

Simulate Before You Commit

HR runs budget scenarios before publishing criteria. See exactly how many employees qualify at each tier before anyone knows the rules.

02

Lock Criteria. Build Trust.

Once published, criteria are immutably locked. Employees see the rules. No mid-cycle changes. Ever.

03

Transparent Outcomes

Every employee gets an Increment Story — a data-driven explanation of their score, tier, and what to improve next cycle.

Capabilities

Everything Your HR Team Needs

🧮

Budget Simulation Engine

Criteria Lock Mechanism
